serie: Loretta Cooks for One: an 81-year-old widow from Iowa cooks small suppers for one from her little cookbook Supper for One
acciones: cutting a recipe down, wrapping a portion in foil, labeling a freezer bag, lifting a lid on a small pot, setting a small table for one, carrying a small baking dish out of the oven
estilo: One ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by her grandson with a phone at eye level, in the middle of the action: framing casual and a little off, something cut by the edge of the frame, almost everything in focus and nothing blurred out, only the light the place really has (a ceiling bulb, a lamp or the daylight from the window), automatic white balance a bit off, slight phone noise, ordinary worn objects of an old Iowa farmhouse, plain bottles and rags with no labels, no beautiful composition.

loretta.desc: Loretta, an 81-year-old white American grandmother with short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron, with old wrinkled hands

lugares_fijos.cocina: Loretta's small 1950s farmhouse kitchen: white enamel stove, yellow gingham curtains, a worn wooden table with one place set, a wall calendar
lugares_fijos.mesa: her small kitchen table set for one: the good plate, a folded napkin, a candle
lugares_fijos.congelador: the freezer drawer of an old white refrigerator, full of flat freezer bags labeled in marker

identidad: Preserve the exact identity, face, short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, age and skin of the elderly woman in the reference photograph. She wears a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron.
